scope: Initial KMS source-derived interface candidates; NOT exhaustive or semantically reconciled

items.name: c.add_argument('--' + key.replace('_', '-'), required=key not in OPTIONAL_INPUTS)
c.add_argument('--%s-key' % role, help='a key file, or a PKCS#11 URI with --key-source engine:pkcs11')

c.add_argument('--%s-key-fd' % role, type=int, metavar='N', help='the offline key (ADR-0002 D28) on descriptor N: a pipe or a sealed memfd from offline-keys.py, never a file; all three keys this way, with --offline-session')
c.add_argument('--%s-cert' % role, required=True, help="the key's X.509 certificate (PEM file)")

dynamicRegistrations.expression: c.add_argument('--%s-key' % role, help='a key file, or a PKCS#11 URI with --key-source engine:pkcs11')

c.add_argument('--%s-key-fd' % role, type=int, metavar='N', help='the offline key (ADR-0002 D28) on descriptor N: a pipe or a sealed memfd from offline-keys.py, never a file; all three keys this way, with --offline-session')
c.add_argument('--%s-cert' % role, required=True, help="the key's X.509 certificate (PEM file)")
c.add_argument('--' + key.replace('_', '-'), required=key not in OPTIONAL_INPUTS)

requiredManualDiscovery: Resolve dynamically registered CLI names, loop arguments and helper-injected options; distinguish hidden internal verbs from supported public commands.
Compare OpenAPI with actual router, health and metrics registration; inspect reflected gRPC and wire operation dispatch.
Review command dispatch switches and custom flag parsers not captured by literal scans.
Enumerate nested configuration fields and persistent record/storage migration contracts; top-level documents and schema constants are only discovery seeds.
Enumerate generated image/service entrypoints, environment/build-tag/backend-dependent registrations and platform-specific behavior.
Verify current forge branch rules and actual required checks; workflow job declarations alone do not establish required status.
Reconcile tracking-repository local deltas and shipped KMS behavior; unchecked tasks alone are not missing implementation.
